# Project Guidelines

## Documentation requirements

After every code change:

- Review the root `README.md` and the `README.md` for each affected module or feature.
- Update documentation when a change affects functionality, setup, usage, configuration, architecture, or examples.
- Keep the root README focused on project-wide information; put module-specific details in the closest relevant subfolder README.
- Create a subfolder README when a new module needs standalone documentation.
- Do not update unrelated READMEs or duplicate the same details across files.
- In your completion summary, list the README files updated, or say why no documentation change was needed.
